questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R)। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : स्वैच्छिक रूप से बेरोज़गार वे सक्षम व्यक्ति होते हैं, जो प्रचलित मज़दूरी दर पर कार्य करने के इच्छुक नहीं होते ।
कारण (R) : संतुलन के पूर्ण रोज़गार स्तर पर अनैच्छिक बेरोज़गारी शून्य होती है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): Voluntarily unemployed people are those able bodied people who are not willing to work at the prevailing wage rate.
Reason (R): There exists zero involuntary unemployment at full employment level of equilibrium.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are factually correct definitions and properties of labor market equilibrium. However, the reason provided (zero involuntary unemployment at full employment) does not explain why people choose to be voluntarily unemployed. Thus, option B is correct.

questions.text: पहचानिए कि एक अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है ।
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following statements is incorrect with reference to an economy.

options.A: सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNP) की सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) पर अधिकता संभव है।
options.B: सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNP) पर अधिकता संभव है।
options.C: सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNP) तथा सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में समानता संभव है।
options.D: सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNP) तथा सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) का योग सदैव शून्य (0) के बराबर होता है ।

options_english.A: Excess of Gross National Product (GNP) over Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is possible.
options_english.B: Excess of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) over Gross National Product (GNP) is possible.
options_english.C: Equality between Gross National Product (GNP) and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is possible.
options_english.D: Sum of Gross National Product (GNP) and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is always equal to zero (0).

questions.solution: Option D is incorrect because GNP and GDP are both measures of total economic production and are positive values; their sum is never zero. The other statements are possible depending on Net Factor Income from Abroad.

questions.text: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में स्फीतिकारी अंतराल तब उपस्थित होता है, जब पूर्ण रोज़गार स्तर पर _______ हो ।
questions.text_english: Inflationary gap in an economy may exist when _______ at full employment level.

options.A: वास्तविक समग्र माँग > संभावित समग्र माँग
options.B: वास्तविक समग्र माँग < संभावित समग्र माँग
options.C: वास्तविक समग्र माँग ≠ संभावित समग्र माँग
options.D: वास्तविक समग्र माँग = संभावित समग्र माँग

options_english.A: Actual Aggregate Demand > Potential Aggregate Demand
options_english.B: Actual Aggregate Demand < Potential Aggregate Demand
options_english.C: Actual Aggregate Demand ≠ Potential Aggregate Demand
options_english.D: Actual Aggregate Demand = Potential Aggregate Demand

questions.solution: An inflationary gap occurs when Actual Aggregate Demand exceeds the level of demand required to maintain full employment (Potential Aggregate Demand). The correct option is A.

questions.text: 19 मई, 2023 को जारी भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) के सांख्यिकीय पूरक के अनुसार: "भारत का विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार (आरक्षित) लगातार तीसरे सप्ताह में वृद्धिमान हुआ है तथा यह $600 अरब के अनुमानित स्तर के करीब पहुँच गया है।" उपर्युक्त स्थिति भारत के भुगतान संतुलन खाते के _______ पक्ष में _______ करेगी।
questions.text_english: According to the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI's) Statistical Supplement released on 19th May, 2023: "India's foreign exchange reserves grew for the third straight week and reached near an approximate level of $600 billion." The above situation will _______ the _______ side of the Balance of Payments account of India.
questions.solution: An increase in foreign exchange reserves is recorded as a credit item in the Balance of Payments account because it represents an inflow or asset accumulation. Therefore, it will increase the credit side. The correct option is A.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन 1 : आरक्षित अनुपात व साख निर्माण प्रक्रिया में ऋणात्मक (व्युत्क्रम) संबंध होता है ।
कथन 2: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था का केन्द्रीय बैंक साख निर्माण प्रक्रिया के नियंत्रण का महत्त्वपूर्ण कार्य करता है ।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Reserve ratio and Credit creation process are inversely related.
Statement 2: Central Bank of an economy performs the vital function of controlling the credit creation process.
In light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true as the money multiplier is 1/reserve ratio, meaning they are inversely related. Statement 2 is also true as the Central Bank regulates credit creation via monetary policy tools. Thus, C is the correct answer.

questions.text: समग्र माँग में किसी भी प्रकार की कमी को हतोत्साहित करने के लिए भारत सरकार _______ में _______ कर सकती है ।
questions.text_english: In order to discourage any fall in Aggregate Demand, the Government of India may _______ the _______.
questions.solution: To discourage a fall in Aggregate Demand (i.e., to stimulate it), the government can decrease tax rates, which increases disposable income and consumption. The correct option is D.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन 1: आय में परिवर्तन (ΔY) के संबंध में उपभोग में परिवर्तन (ΔC) की स्थिर दर के कारण उपभोग वक्र एक सीधी रेखा होता है ।
कथन 2 : उपभोग व आय के मध्य परिवर्तन की सीमांत दर को औसत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (APC) के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement 1: Constant rate of change of consumption (ΔC) with respect to change in income (ΔY), is the reason for the straight line consumption curve.
Statement 2: Marginal rate of change between consumption and income is defined as Average Propensity to Consume (APC).
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true because constant MPC leads to a linear consumption function. Statement 2 is false because the marginal rate of change is MPC, not APC (APC is C/Y). Therefore, A is correct.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : प्रतिकूल व्यापार संतुलन की स्थिति में, एक राष्ट्र का चालू खाता अधिशेष में हो सकता है ।
कारण (R) : किसी राष्ट्र की निवल अदृश्य प्राप्तियाँ, निवल दृश्य प्राप्तियों से अधिक हो सकती हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): In case of an unfavourable Balance of Trade, the Current Account of the nation may be in surplus.
Reason (R): Net invisible receipts of a nation can exceed the Net visible receipts.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Unfavourable trade balance means deficit in visible items, but if invisible receipts (services, income, transfers) are large enough to cover this, the current account can still result in a surplus. Thus, both are true and R explains A.

questions.text: (क) दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, राष्ट्रीय आय के मूल्य का आकलन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: (a) On the basis of the given data, estimate the value of National Income:

key_points: GDPmp = GFCF + PFCE + GDFCF + Net Exports + Increase in Stock
NNPfc = GDPmp - CFC - Indirect Taxes + Subsidies + NFIA

sub_questions.solution: National Income (NNPfc) is calculated by adding Private Final Consumption Expenditure (200), Government Final Consumption Expenditure (110), Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation (30), and Increase in Stock (20), then subtracting Net Exports (-40), arriving at a GDPmp of 320. Deducting Consumption of Fixed Capital (15), Indirect Taxes (60), adding Subsidies (15), and adjusting for NFIA (-40), the final National Income is 230 crore.

questions.solution: National Income (NNPfc) = Private Final Consumption Expenditure + Government Final Consumption Expenditure + Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation + Increase in Stock + Net Exports - Consumption of Fixed Capital - Net Indirect Taxes + Net Factor Income from Abroad. Calculation: 200 + 110 + 30 + 20 - 40 - 15 - (60 - 15) + (-40) = 320 - 15 - 45 - 40 = 220 crore (Re-check: 200+110+30+20-40 = 320. 320 - 15 - 45 - 40 = 220).

questions.text: किसी राष्ट्र की विदेशी मुद्रा की माँग को प्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित करने वाले किन्हीं दो कारकों की विवेचना कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Discuss any two factors which directly affect the demand for foreign exchange of a nation.

key_points: Import of goods and services
Speculative activities

questions.solution: The first factor is the import of goods and services from other countries, which creates a demand for foreign currency to pay for these imports. The second factor is speculative activities, where investors demand foreign currency in the expectation of future changes in exchange rates to earn profits.

questions.text: किसी द्वि-क्षेत्रक अर्थव्यवस्था में समग्र पूर्ति के दो घटकों की विस्तार से व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Elaborate the two components of Aggregate Supply in a two-sector economy.

key_points: Consumption (C)
Savings (S)

questions.solution: In a two-sector economy, Aggregate Supply (AS) is represented by the total output produced, which is equal to national income. The two components are Consumption (C) and Savings (S). Consumption refers to the portion of income spent on goods and services, while Savings represents the portion of income that is not consumed and is set aside for future use.

questions.text: (क) "भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) द्वारा खुले बाज़ार में संचालन (Open Market Operations) अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा आपूर्ति को विनियमित करने में सहायता करते हैं।" मान्य तर्कों सहित दिए गए कथन को सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) "Open Market Operations by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) help in regulating money supply in the economy." Justify the given statement with valid arguments.

key_points: Definition of OMO
Sale of securities reduces money supply
Purchase of securities increases money supply

questions.solution: Open Market Operations (OMO) involve the RBI buying or selling government securities in the open market. When the RBI sells securities, it absorbs liquidity from the banking system, thereby reducing the money supply. Conversely, when it purchases securities, it injects cash into the system, increasing the money supply, thus allowing the RBI to effectively manage inflation and economic growth.

questions.text:
(क) एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए, सरकार ₹ 5,000 करोड़ का अतिरिक्त निवेश व्यय करती है । यह मानते हुए कि सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) अपने 20% के वर्तमान स्तर से आधी हो गई है, सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) में इस गिरावट के कारण आय में परिवर्तन का अनुमान लगाइए ।
(ख) स्वायत्त निवेश का अर्थ लिखिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) For a hypothetical economy, the government incurs an additional investment expenditure of ₹ 5,000 crore. Assuming that the Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) becomes half from its present level of 20%, estimate the change in income due to this fall in Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS).
(b) State the meaning of autonomous investment.

key_points: Initial MPS = 0.2, New MPS = 0.1
Initial Multiplier (k) = 1/0.2 = 5
New Multiplier (k) = 1/0.1 = 10
Change in Income (ΔY) = k × ΔI = 10 × 5000 = 50,000 crore

questions.solution: The initial MPS was 0.2, making the multiplier 5. With MPS falling to half (0.1), the new multiplier is 10. Given an investment expenditure of 5,000 crore, the change in income is calculated as 10 multiplied by 5,000, resulting in 50,000 crore. Autonomous investment refers to investment spending that is independent of the level of income in the economy.

questions.text:
(क) (i) एक द्वि-क्षेत्रक अर्थव्यवस्था में आय के चक्रीय प्रवाह की अवधारणा की व्याख्या कीजिए।
(ii) "किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) तथा सकल मूल्य वर्धित (GVA) का योग सदैव बराबर होता है।" मान्य तर्कों सहित दिए गए कथन को सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Explain the concept of circular flow of income in a two-sector economy.
(ii) "Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and the sum of Gross Value Added (GVA) in an economy are always equal." Justify the given statement with valid arguments.

key_points: Circular flow: Household provides factors, gets income; Firm provides goods, gets revenue.
GVA = Value of Output - Intermediate Consumption.
Sum of GVA across sectors = GDPmp.

questions.solution: In a two-sector economy, households provide factor services to firms and receive income in return, which they spend on goods and services produced by firms. This creates a continuous circular flow. Regarding GVA, it is the value created by a firm after deducting intermediate costs. Summing the GVA of all sectors gives the total value produced within the domestic territory, which is by definition the GDP at market prices.

questions.text:
(क) दी गई सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित के मूल्यों की गणना कीजिए :
(i) राजकोषीय घाटा
(ii) प्राथमिक घाटा
(ख) निजी वस्तुओं के किन्हीं दो उदाहरणों का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
(ग) 'सार्वजनिक प्रावधान' व 'सार्वजनिक उत्पादन' में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) On the basis of the given information, calculate the values of the following:
(i) Fiscal Deficit
(ii) Primary Deficit
(b) State any two examples of private goods.
(c) Distinguish between 'Public Provision' and 'Public Production'.

key_points: Fiscal Deficit = Total Exp - (Revenue Receipts + Non-debt Capital Receipts)
Non-debt Capital = 50% of 20 = 10
Fiscal Deficit = 30 + 10 - 20 - 10 = 10
Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments = 10 - 10 = 0

questions.solution: Based on the data, the Fiscal Deficit is 10 crore, calculated by total expenditure minus total receipts excluding borrowings. The Primary Deficit is 0, as Fiscal Deficit minus Interest Payments equals 10 - 10. Private goods examples include clothes and food. Public provision means the government provides the good (e.g., through subsidies), while public production means the government directly produces it (e.g., public sector schools).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : ब्रिटिश शासन के अंतर्गत कृषि क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से भारत के क्षेत्रीय विकास का आधार था ।

questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): The agricultural sector under the British rule was primarily the base of the sectoral growth of India.
Reason (R): British rulers wanted to take maximum advantage of the Indian agricultural output, for growth of industries in England.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Under British rule, agriculture was the main economic base for India, and they exploited it as a source of raw materials for British industries. Thus, both are true and R explains A.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

questions.text:
पहचानिए कि चीनी अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से विकल्प सही नहीं हैं।
(i) 1958 में, कम्यूनों की स्थापना हुई थी ।
(ii) विदेशी क्षेत्र में, विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र (Special Economic Zones) स्थापित हुए थे ।
(iii) बेहतर स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं ने चीन में मृत्यु दर में कमी की थी ।
questions.text_english:
Identify which of the following alternatives are not true with reference to the Chinese economy.
(i) In 1958, communes were established.
(ii) In the foreign sector, Special Economic Zones (SEZ) were set up.
(iii) Better health facilities reduced mortality rate in China.
questions.solution: Actually, all these statements are historically true regarding the Chinese economy, so none of these options correctly identifies a 'not true' statement. Since the instruction asks for which are not true, and all are true, this question appears to have an error or expects the answer indicating all are true.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से नियमित कृषि बाज़ार का उद्देश्य नहीं है/हैं ?
(i) कृषकों के लिए विपणन के बुनियादी ढाँचे में सुधार करने के लिए हतोत्साहित करना ।
(ii) कृषकों को उनके उत्पादों का सर्वोत्तम मूल्य दिलाने के लिए विपणन प्रणाली को कुशल व प्रभावी बनाना ।
(iii) कृषकों को उनकी उपज की मात्रा व गुणवत्ता में सुधार करने के लिए हतोत्साहित करना ।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following is/are not an objective of regulated agricultural market?
(i) To discourage improvement of marketing infrastructure for farmers.
(ii) To make marketing systems efficient and effective for farmers to get best price for their products.
(iii) To discourage farmers to improve the quantity and quality of their produce.
questions.solution: Regulated markets aim to encourage infrastructure and quality improvement, not discourage them. Statements (i) and (iii) represent objectives that are the opposite of the market's purpose. Therefore, A is correct.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन 1: कृषि क्षेत्र में समानता को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए भूमि की अधिकतम सीमा निर्धारण सरकारी नीतियों में से एक नीति थी ।
कथन 2 : स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में भू-सुधारों के परिणामस्वरूप ज़मींदारी प्रथा का उन्मूलन हो गया था ।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Land ceiling was one of the Government policies to promote equity in the agriculture sector.
Statement 2: Land reforms resulted in abolition of the Zamindari system in the post independence period.
In light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are historically accurate. Land ceiling aimed at equitable distribution of land, and land reforms successfully abolished the exploitative Zamindari system. C is correct.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : भारत सरकार द्वारा 8 नवम्बर, 2016 को वस्तु व सेवा कर (GST) लागू किया गया था ।
कारण (R) : GST भारत में एकीकृत अप्रत्यक्ष कर प्रणाली को लागू करने के लिए लाया गया था ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative given below :
Assertion (A): Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented by the Government of India on 8th November, 2016.
Reason (R): GST was introduced to implement a unified indirect tax system in India.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is false because GST was not implemented on November 8, 2016 (that date was demonetization). GST was introduced on July 1, 2017. Reason (R) is true. Thus, D is correct.

questions.text: पहचानिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन G20 का सदस्य राष्ट्र नहीं है ।
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following is not a member nation of G20.
questions.solution: Bangladesh is not a member of the G20, whereas Argentina, Australia, and Brazil are members. Thus, D is the correct answer.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: एक विशिष्ट फ़सल के बदले विभिन्न प्रकार की फ़सलों का उत्पादन _______ का विविधीकरण कहलाता है ।
questions.text_english: Production of varied forms of crops against one specialised crop is called diversification of _______.
questions.solution: Diversification from a single crop to various crops is known as crop diversification. The correct option is C.

questions.text: पहचानिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मानव विकास संकेतक (HDI) नहीं है ।
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following is not a Human Development Indicator (HDI).
questions.solution: The Human Development Index (HDI) is calculated based on health (Life Expectancy), education (Literacy/Schooling), and standard of living (Income). Unemployment is not a direct component of the standard HDI index. Thus, D is correct.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन 1 : मानव विकास इस विचार पर आधारित है कि शिक्षा व स्वास्थ्य मानव कल्याण के अभिन्न अंग हैं ।
कथन 2 : मानव पूँजी मानव को किसी साध्य की प्राप्ति का साधन मानती है ।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Human development is based on the idea that education and health are integral to human well-being.
Statement 2: Human capital treats humans as a means to an end.
In light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 correctly describes the focus of human development. Statement 2 correctly characterizes human capital, which views humans as an input or 'means' for greater economic productivity. Both are true, so C is correct.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की वार्षिक वृद्धि (%) के संदर्भ में असत्य कथन की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: On the basis of the data given below, identify the incorrect statement with reference to annual growth of GDP (%) :

options.A: पाकिस्तान व चीन ने 2015-2017 के दौरान विकास दर में गिरावट का अनुभव किया था ।
options.B: चीन ने 1980 - 1990 में दोहरे अंकों की विकास दर हासिल की थी ।
options.C: 2015-2017 की अवधि में भारत की GDP दर में मध्यम रूप से तेजी आई थी ।
options.D: 1980 - 2017 के दौरान GDP के मामले में पाकिस्तान भारत से आगे था ।

options_english.A: Pakistan and China experienced a fall in growth rate during 2015-2017.
options_english.B: China achieved double-digit growth rate in 1980 - 1990.
options_english.C: GDP of India accelerated moderately in 2015 - 2017 period.
options_english.D: Pakistan was ahead of India during 1980-2017 in terms of GDP.

questions.solution: Looking at the data, India's growth rate was higher than Pakistan's in both periods (5.7 > 5.3 and 7.3 > 5.3), so the statement that Pakistan was ahead of India is incorrect. D is correct.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
(क) "1991 के सुधार पश्चात् की अवधि में भारत की व्यापार और निवेश नीति में व्यापक परिवर्तन आए थे।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? किन्हीं दो मान्य तर्कों सहित अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।

(ख) 1950-1990 की अवधि के दौरान भारतीय औद्योगिक क्षेत्र की किन्हीं दो मुख्य विशेषताओं की चर्चा कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "Trade and Investment Policy of India had undergone comprehensive changes in the post-reforms period of 1991." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with any two valid arguments.

(b) Discuss any two salient features of the Indian industrial sector during the period 1950-1990.

key_points: Post 1991: Removal of quantitative restrictions, reduction in tariffs.
1950-90: Import substitution, public sector dominance

questions.solution: Yes, I agree. Post-1991, India removed quantitative restrictions on imports and reduced tariff rates significantly to integrate with the global economy. Regarding the 1950-1990 industrial sector, two main features were the policy of import substitution to achieve self-reliance and the dominant role assigned to the public sector in core industries.

questions.text:
"भारत में, राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 में शिक्षकों के सेवाकालीन प्रशिक्षण पर अत्यधिक बल दिया गया है।"
(i) उपर्युक्त कथन में इंगित मानव पूँजी निर्माण (HCF) के स्रोत की पहचान कीजिए।
(ii) भारत के आर्थिक विकास पर इस स्रोत के संभावित प्रभावों की विस्तार से व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
"In India, National Education Policy 2020 has stressed a lot on in-service training of the teachers."
(i) Identify the source of Human Capital Formation (HCF) indicated in the aforesaid statement.
(ii) Elaborate the likely impacts of this source on the economic development of India.

key_points: Source: Expenditure on training.
Impact: Higher productivity, better quality of education.

questions.solution: The indicated source of Human Capital Formation is 'Expenditure on on-the-job training'. Increased training for teachers enhances their pedagogical skills and subject knowledge, which significantly improves the quality of education for students. This, in turn, boosts human capital quality, ultimately leading to higher labor productivity and sustained long-term economic development for India.

questions.text: दिए गए आँकड़ों से, सकल मूल्य वर्धित (GVA) में भारत व चीन के क्षेत्रीय योगदान की तुलना व विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: From the given data, compare and analyse India and China's sectoral contribution towards Gross Value Added (GVA).

key_points: China's Industry share (41%) > India's (30%)
India's Service share (54%) > China's (52%)
Agriculture share (India 16%, China 7%)

questions.solution: The data shows significant structural differences. China's industrial contribution to GVA (41%) is substantially higher than India's (30%), reflecting China's focus on becoming a manufacturing hub. While both countries have a strong service sector (India 54%, China 52%), India's agricultural dependence (16%) is higher than China's (7%), indicating China's more advanced structural transformation compared to India.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
(क) वैध तर्कों द्वारा उल्लेख व व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं या असत्य :
(i) जैविक खेती अनिवार्य रूप से वर्तमान समय की माँग बन गई है ।
(ii) हाल में, भारत सरकार ने वित्तीय संसाधनों के कुशलतम आबंटन के लिए जन-धन योजना जैसे कई महत्त्वपूर्ण कदम उठाए हैं ।
questions.text_english:
(a) State and elaborate whether the following statements are true or false, with valid arguments:
(i) Organic Farming has essentially become the need of the hour.
(ii) In the recent past, the Government of India has taken crucial steps, like Jan-Dhan Yojana, for efficient allocation of financial resources.

key_points: Statement (i) is True: Reduces chemical toxicity and improves long-term soil health.
Statement (ii) is True: Improves financial inclusion and direct benefit transfer efficiency.

questions.solution: Statement (i) is true. Organic farming is essential now to reduce soil degradation and health issues caused by excessive chemical usage. Statement (ii) is also true. The Jan-Dhan Yojana has significantly enhanced financial inclusion, allowing for the direct and efficient transfer of government benefits, thereby minimizing leakage and optimizing resource allocation.

questions.text:
दिए गए चित्र का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
चित्र में दर्शाई गई परिस्थिति की पहचान कीजिए तथा भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था पर संकेतित स्थिति के प्रभाव का सुझाव दीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Study the given image carefully :
Identify the situation depicted in the image and suggest the impact of the indicated situation in the Indian economy.

key_points: Situation: Informal sector street vending/casual labor.
Impact: Job insecurity, low income, lack of social security

questions.solution: The image depicts a crowded market scene indicative of the informal sector, where casual labor or small-scale street vending is prevalent. The impact of such a large informal sector in the Indian economy is characterized by high job insecurity, low and unstable income levels, and the absence of social security benefits, which keeps a large segment of the workforce economically vulnerable.

questions.text:
(क) (i) "भारत में आधारिक संरचना के विकास के पीछे वास्तविक उद्देश्य ब्रिटिश हितों को सुदृढ़ करना था।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? वैध तर्कों सहित अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।
(ii) "नवरत्न नीति से सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों (PSU) के रखरखाव, प्रचार को प्रोत्साहित करने व विनिवेश को बढ़ावा देने में सुविधा हुई है।" मान्य स्पष्टीकरण के साथ दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "The real motive behind infrastructural development in India was to strengthen British interests." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with valid arguments.
(ii) "Navratna policy has facilitated the maintenance, promotion and disinvestment of Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)." Justify the given statement with valid explanation.

key_points: Infrastructure: Railways were built to transport raw materials and move military.
Navratna: Grants autonomy to efficient PSUs to compete globally and improves performance.

questions.solution: Yes, I agree. The British developed infrastructure like railways primarily to facilitate the transportation of raw materials from the hinterland to ports and to ensure quick movement of their troops. Regarding the Navratna policy, it has been instrumental in granting managerial and operational autonomy to high-performing PSUs. This autonomy has enabled them to professionalize, compete effectively in global markets, and perform better, which in turn facilitates their strategic disinvestment.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence / Economic Reforms

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए:

समकालीन विश्व में जहाँ सतत विकास को लेकर बहुत सारी चिंताएँ हैं, हरित विकास तथा शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन ऐसी दो महत्त्वपूर्ण अवधारणाएँ हैं जिनकी आमतौर पर एक साथ चर्चा की जाती है। ये दो अवधारणाएँ पृथ्वी के भविष्य के लिए अतिसंवेदनशील हैं, क्योंकि इन पर एक साथ काम करके, हम अपने लिए तथा आने वाली पीढ़ियों के लिए एक अधिक स्थायी भविष्य का निर्माण कर सकते हैं।

हरित विकास उस आर्थिक विकास को संदर्भित करता है "जो पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव को कम करने के तरीके से हासिल किया गया है," जबकि "शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन ग्रीनहाउस गैसों के मानवजनित उत्सर्जन व वायुमंडल से ऐसे उत्सर्जन को हटाने के बीच संतुलन प्राप्त करने की स्थिति है।"

दोनों अवधारणाओं के बीच एक मजबूत संबंध मौजूद है:
(1) हरित विकास ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जन को कम करने में सहायक है, जो शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक है।
(2) हरित विकास नौकरियाँ उत्पन्न करने में व आर्थिक विकास को प्रोत्साहित करने में सहायक है, जो देशों के लिए शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन प्रौद्योगिकी में निवेश को अधिक किफायती बनाने में सहायता कर सकता है।

एक राष्ट्र इन दोनों कारकों को एक साथ वृद्धि देने के लिए बहुत कुछ कर सकता है, जैसे:
(क) नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा स्रोतों में निवेश, जो ग्रीनहाउस गैसों का उत्पादन नहीं करते हैं।
(ख) ऊर्जा कुशल उपायों को अपनाना जैसे इन्सुलेशन और अन्य ऐसे उपकरण जो ऊर्जा की खपत को कम करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।
(ग) परिवहन की आदतों में परिवर्तन जैसे पैदल चलना, साइकिल चलाना व सार्वजनिक परिवहन का उपयोग करना, क्योंकि ये यात्रा करने के लिए अल्प-कार्बन उत्सर्जन वाले तरीके हैं।

दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully:

In the contemporary world with a lot of sustainable development concerns, green growth and net zero emissions are two important concepts which are generally discussed together. These two concepts are essential for the future of the Earth, as by working together on them we can create a more sustainable future for ourselves and for the generations to come.

Green growth refers to "the economic growth that is achieved in a way that minimizes environmental impact," whereas "net zero emission is the state of achieving balance between anthropogenic emission of greenhouse gases and removal of such emissions from the atmosphere."

There exists a robust connection between the two concepts:
(1) Green growth can help to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, which is essential for achieving net zero emissions.
(2) Green growth can help to create jobs and boost economic growth, which can help to make it more affordable for countries to invest in net zero emissions technology.

A nation can do a lot to promote these two factors together, like:
(a) Investing in renewable energy sources which do not produce greenhouse gases.
(b) Adopting energy-efficient measures, such as insulation and other such appliances which can help to reduce energy consumption.
(c) Altering transportation habits, like adopting walking, biking and using public transportation as they are lower-carbon ways to travel.

On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: हरित विकास व शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन का अर्थ बताइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State the meaning of green growth and net zero emissions.

key_points: Green growth: Economic growth that minimizes environmental impact.
Net zero emission: Balance between GHG emissions and removals.

sub_questions.solution: Green growth is economic growth achieved while minimizing negative environmental impacts. Net zero emission is the state where human-induced greenhouse gas emissions are perfectly balanced by their removal from the atmosphere.

sub_questions.text: हरित विकास और शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन के बीच अंतर्संबंध पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Discuss briefly the interconnection between green growth and net zero emissions.

key_points: Reduces GHG emissions.
Creates economic capacity to invest in net zero technology.

sub_questions.solution: The two concepts are interconnected because green growth reduces the overall greenhouse gas emissions, which is a prerequisite for net zero. Furthermore, green growth stimulates economic development and job creation, generating the financial capacity for nations to afford investments in advanced net zero emission technologies.

sub_questions.text: शुद्ध शून्य उत्सर्जन को प्रोत्साहित करने वाले किसी एक कारक को सोदाहरण स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Illustrate any one factor to promote net zero emission.

key_points: Renewable energy investment, e.g., solar/wind.

sub_questions.solution: Investment in renewable energy sources, such as solar or wind power, promotes net zero emissions because these sources generate energy without producing harmful greenhouse gases that contribute to global warming.
